description: LiNa₂B₅P₂O₁₄ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/m space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.71 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.91 Å. Li is bonded to four O atoms to form LiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra and corners with three BO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 1.93-2.05 Å. There are five inequivalent B sites. In the first B site, B is bonded to four O atoms to form BO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one LiO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one BO₄ tetrahedra, and corners with two equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of B-O bond distances ranging from 1.43-1.54 Å. In the second B site, B is bonded to four O atoms to form BO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one LiO₄ tetrahedra and corners with two equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of B-O bond distances ranging from 1.45-1.50 Å. In the third B site, B is bonded to four O atoms to form BO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one LiO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one BO₄ tetrahedra, and corners with two equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of B-O bond distances ranging from 1.43-1.53 Å. In the fourth B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of B-O bond distances ranging from 1.36-1.41 Å. In the fifth B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.36 Å) and one longer (1.40 Å) B-O bond length. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one LiO₄ tetrahedra and corners with three BO₄ tetrahedra. There is one shorter (1.51 Å) and three longer (1.57 Å) P-O bond lengths. There are ten inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na, one B, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na, one B, and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na, one B, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Li, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na and two B atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Li and two B atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Li and two B atoms. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two B atoms. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na and two B atoms. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two B atoms.
